about.title: About LLMField
about.backgroundDesc: LLMField is an open-source data project maintained by AI enthusiasts, collecting and curating publicly available data on Chinese LLMs to serve as a reference for developers and researchers. This site does not produce data — all data comes from public sources.
about.backgroundContribute: If you spot an error or would like to add new model information, feel free to submit an issue on
about.scoringDesc: This page displays raw benchmark scores from public evaluation frameworks, covering intelligence, coding, agent, and math dimensions. Users can sort by any dimension.
about.scoringDetail: The Intelligence Index combines benchmarks like MMLU, HumanEval, and MATH to evaluate reasoning, coding, and math capabilities using a standardized 0-100+ scoring system.
about.costDetail: Pricing data sourced from official model websites or pricing documentation, standardized as price per million tokens (¥/M or $/M).
about.filterDesc: The ranking data is produced by an upstream 4-step data pipeline, ensuring models are current, comparable, and data-complete.
about.filterStep1Desc: From all models indexed by Artificial Analysis, Chinese models are identified by dual matching on company name and model name keywords (covering 19 vendors).
about.filterStep2Desc: Only models with size_class "Large" are retained. Duplicate models are deduplicated, keeping the variant with the highest intelligence score.
about.filterStep3Desc: Vendor links and official domestic pricing are injected. Models released within the last 180 days are kept as active.
about.filterStep4Desc: Each model is flagged for data completeness — intelligence scores, API speed tests, and pricing data must all be available to qualify, ensuring comparability across all three dimensions.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai) is an authoritative LLM performance evaluation organization providing standardized benchmarks and data.
about.sourceAaDetail: The Intelligence Index combines multiple benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, etc.) to evaluate reasoning, coding, and math capabilities with a standardized scoring system.
about.priceSourceDesc: Official model websites or pricing documentation
about.priceDetail: Prioritizes domestic official pricing (¥). Falls back to Artificial Analysis blended pricing ($) when domestic pricing is unavailable. Price data updated weekly.
about.updateDesc: Data is continuously tracked for new model versions and pricing changes, with regular updates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This site is for reference only and does not constitute investment or usage advice. Model performance varies by use case, and actual experience may differ from the data presented.
